en: Black‑and‑white image of a broad cobbled town square bordered by 3‑ to 4‑story gabled houses with shops on the ground floor. Awnings extend over the sidewalks, with several clearly visible German shop signs. A few women in long dresses walk across the otherwise open square, and tall ornate street lamps with hanging flower baskets line the space. The architecture is late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century Central European, giving a calm small‑town atmosphere.
